name: resume-galley
description: A section-based resume editor. Import the resume you already have, edit it as labelled fields instead of a canvas, and export Word, PDF or plain text.
author: Anuka Rashmi Kumar

scripts.fixtures: node src/make-fixtures.js && node src/make-subset-pdf.js && node src/make-layout-pdf.js && node src/make-ctm-pdf.js
scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['app.html','index.html']){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');let b=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){const c=s.charCodeAt(i);if(c===0xFFFD||c<9||(c>13&&c<32))b++;}console.log(f, b?('control chars: '+b):'clean');}"
